summary: Sorsogon 1st District representative with 180 principal-authored bills. Authored no-balance billing, mental health units in public hospitals, free senior immunization, MSME credit allocation and compliance-cost cuts, business tax relief, electricity VAT exemption, installment-buyer protection, disqualification of officials' relatives from contracts and adolescent pregnancy prevention.
caveat: Adolescent pregnancy and relatives-contract bills are single issues and unscored. Business tax relief is balanced against health and consumer bills.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored no-balance billing and public mental health units (-3), consumer protection for installment buyers (-2) and public-sector pay (-2), against business tax relief and MSME compliance-cost cuts (+2) with a mandatory MSME credit allocation (-2).
